summary: Re-tested lead validation, form success/error handling, mobile navigation, FAQ, and overflow against the public preview.

ui_bugs.issue: Clicking the first FAQ question on mobile does not render its answer; the button remains collapsed.

action_items: Fix FAQ accordion click/state behavior on mobile and retest all FAQ items.
critical_code_review_comments: FAQ state is controlled by openFaq and should render faq-answer-0 after a user click; the live mobile preview does not reflect the click despite the button being visible and clickable.
seed_data_creation: Created one valid quote lead through regression API testing and valid quote/valuation leads through UI testing; no cleanup endpoint exists.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public API validation passed: valid quote returns 200; invalid type and weak/overlong phones return 422. UI quote and valuation invalid-phone errors and valid success states pass. Mobile menu opens, navigation works, and no horizontal overflow is present. FAQ accordion remains unverified/failing on mobile: click [data-testid=faq-question-0] did not create [data-testid=faq-answer-0].
rca of the issue: The live DOM contains the FAQ button but the controlled openFaq state does not appear to change after a normal mobile click. Inspect event delivery/overlay and verify deployed bundle matches App.js FAQ handler: setOpenFaq(openFaq === index ? -1 : index).
